scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist/client/wrangler.json', {force:true}); fs.rmSync('dist/server/wrangler.json', {force:true}); fs.rmSync('.wrangler', {force:true, recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('dist/server', 'dist/client/server', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('lib', 'dist/client/lib', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('dist/client/functions', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('pages-worker.ts', 'dist/client/functions/_middleware.ts');"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy ./dist/client --project-name=catalogo-vip
